# CONTEXT.md — Rust Core (`src-tauri`)

The Tauri **Rust core** — the transport client, the client-side **state of
record**, and the bridge to the webview. The **only** thing that talks gRPC
to the runtime-core. The webview never does.

Read `../CONTEXT.md` for the project overview. Wire types are in
`../proto/operator.proto`. For per-ADR status see `cambrian-knowledge/adrs/`.

## Module Map

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `build.rs` | `tonic-build` codegen — generates `OperatorConsole` client from `../proto/operator.proto`. |
| `src/pb.rs` | `tonic::include_proto!("cambrian")` + `PINNED_CONTRACT_VERSION` (the pinned operator contract, `0101`; history in the file) + plugin skew table. |
| `src/links.rs` | Identity plane review lane (contract 0098): candidates, confirm, retract. |
| `src/accounts.rs` | Premium AccountsAdmin plane (ADR-0141, capability `accounts`): personal accounts (start/poll/list/disconnect/confirm), operator ListAccounts/RevokeAccount, org accounts + grants, provider OAuth clients. Metadata only; the sign-in `start_url` is opened in the system browser by `op_start_account_connect` (http/https only, `openable_url`) and never returned to the webview. |
| `src/state.rs` | `StateOfRecord` — idempotent absolute-state fold (last-writer-wins by id). |
| `src/transport.rs` | gRPC client + `AuthInterceptor` (bearer), login, feed loop (`run_feed`/`drain`/`backoff`). |
| `src/lib.rs` | Tauri bridge: managed `Transport` state + `op_*` commands + `run()`. |
| `src/dev_bridge/` | Dev only (`dev-bridge` feature, debug builds, `CAMBRIAN_STUDIO_BRIDGE=1`): a `127.0.0.1:1430` WebSocket relaying `op_*` commands and `kernel://*` events to a browser tab (`../src/ipc/bridge/`). Origin-checked. `dispatch.rs` is generated by `../scripts/gen-dev-bridge.py`; a test fails when it is stale. |

**Internal rule**: all `tonic`/`prost` types stay in `pb.rs`/`transport.rs`.
The webview receives only plain serde types over Tauri events.

## Recovery, auth and the operator plane

These facts live in the knowledge cards, not here:

- Feed loop, `Snapshot` / `StreamEvents(last_seq)` / `ResyncRequired` recovery, the idempotent
  fold, backoff and "kernel unreachable" → card.ui.operator-transport.
- `Login` / OIDC, the bearer token and the OS keychain, role probe, sign-out → card.ui.auth-sessions.
- Which services make up the operator plane (pinned `OperatorConsole` + capability-gated premium
  planes on the same channel and token; never the agent-facing `Orchestrator`) → card.concept.planes
  and root `AGENTS.md` §5.2.
